reasoning: This question asks about daily average temperatures at Strasbourg Airport on two dates in late October and early November 2025. November 2nd is typically cooler than October 26th in Strasbourg due to seasonal progression. October 26 is still in autumn's warmer period, while November 2 is early November when temperatures have declined. Historical climate data shows average temperatures drop roughly 1-2°C per week in this transition period. The probability that a single day in early November exceeds a single day in late October is low, though daily variability means it's not impossible.
